<script lang="ts">
	import { goto } from '$app/navigation';

	import { page } from '$app/state';

	import { Button } from '#lib/components/ui/button/index.js';
	import { Badge } from '#lib/components/ui/badge/index.js';
	import * as Card from '#lib/components/ui/card/index.js';
	import * as AlertDialog from '#lib/components/ui/alert-dialog/index.js';


	import { deleteTaskType } from '#lib/stores/common_task.ts';


	import { onMount } from 'svelte';
	import { entityNavigation, pushChild, popTo, resetNavigation, markDirty, clearDirty } from '#lib/stores/entity-navigation.ts';
	import { apiGet, apiPost, apiDelete } from '#lib/api/client.ts';

	import { TimeAgo } from '@crewbase/entities';
	import { toast } from 'svelte-sonner';
	import * as m from '#lib/paraglide/messages.js';
	import * as fmt from '#lib/format.ts';
	import type { TaskTypeResponse, SubTaskTypeResponse } from '#lib/api/types.ts';

	interface Props {
		data: {
			item: TaskTypeResponse;
		};
	}

	let { data }: Props = $props();
	let item = $state(data.item);

	const basePath = '/common/task';


	let deleteDialogOpen = $state(false);
	let deleting = $state(false);



	let expandedSections = $state(new Set<string>());

	let sub_taskItems = $state<SubTaskTypeResponse[]>([]);


	function toggleSection(name: string) {
		expandedSections = new Set(expandedSections);
		if (expandedSections.has(name)) {
			expandedSections.delete(name);
		} else {
			expandedSections.add(name);
		}
	}

	async function loadChildren() {

		try {
			const res = await apiGet<SubTaskTypeResponse[]>('/common/sub-task', { parent_id: item.id });
			sub_taskItems = res ?? [];
		} catch {
			sub_taskItems = [];
		}

	}

	function startAddChild(domain: string, pathSegment: string) {
		goto(`/${domain}/${pathSegment}/new?parent_id=${item.id}`);
	}

	function editChild(domain: string, pathSegment: string, childId: string) {
		goto(`/${domain}/${pathSegment}/${childId}/edit`);
	}

	function manageChild(domain: string, pathSegment: string, childId: string) {
		pushChild(
			{
				label: 'TaskType',
				path: `${basePath}/${item.id}`,
				entityType: 'TaskType',
				entityId: item.id,
			},
			{
				parentId: item.id,
				parentType: 'TaskType',
				parentLabel: 'TaskType',
			}
		);
		goto(`/${domain}/${pathSegment}/${childId}`);
	}

	async function deleteChild(domain: string, pathSegment: string, childId: string) {
		try {
			await apiDelete(`/${domain}/${pathSegment}/${childId}`);
			toast.success(m.common_child_deleted());
			await loadChildren();
		} catch (e) {
			toast.error(m.common_delete_failed({ error: (e as Error).message }));
		}
	}

	onMount(() => {
		loadChildren();
	});



	async function handleDelete() {
		deleting = true;
		try {

			await deleteTaskType(item.id);

			toast.success(m.common_entity_deleted({ entity: 'TaskType' }));
			goto(basePath);
		} catch (e) {
			toast.error(m.common_delete_failed({ error: (e as Error).message }));
		} finally {
			deleting = false;
			deleteDialogOpen = false;
		}
	}



</script>

<div class="space-y-6">
	<!-- Header -->
	<div class="flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">

					<a href={basePath} class="hover:text-foreground hover:underline">&larr; {m.common_back_to_list()}</a>
					{#each $entityNavigation.breadcrumbs as crumb, i}
						<span class="mx-1">/</span>
						<button
							class="hover:text-foreground hover:underline"
							onclick={() => { popTo(i); goto(crumb.path); }}
							type="button"
						>
							{crumb.label} ({crumb.entityId.slice(0, 8)})
						</button>
					{/each}
					<span class="mx-1">/</span>
					<span class="text-foreground font-medium">TaskType</span>
				</nav>
			{:else}
				<a href={basePath} class="text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:underline">
					&larr; Back to list
				</a>
			{/if}


			<h2 class="mt-1 text-xl font-semibold">{m.common_task_title()}</h2>
		</div>
		<div class="flex gap-2">

{#if page.data.organization?.role === 'owner'}
			<Button variant="outline" href={`${basePath}/${item.id}/edit`} data-testid="task-edit-btn">
				{m.common_edit()}
			</Button>
{/if}



			{#if page.data.organization?.role === 'owner'}
				<Button variant="destructive" onclick={() => deleteDialogOpen = true} data-testid="task-delete-btn">
					{m.common_delete()}
				</Button>
			{/if}


		</div>
	</div>



	<!-- Fields -->
	<Card.Root>
		<Card.Content class="p-0">
			<dl class="divide-y divide-border">

				<div class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-1 px-4 py-3 sm:grid-cols-3 sm:gap-4">
					<dt class="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">{m.common_created_at()}</dt>
					<dd class="text-sm sm:col-span-2">{#if item.created_at}<TimeAgo value={item.created_at} />{:else}—{/if}</dd>
				</div>
				<div class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-1 px-4 py-3 sm:grid-cols-3 sm:gap-4">
					<dt class="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">{m.common_updated_at()}</dt>
					<dd class="text-sm sm:col-span-2">{#if item.updated_at}<TimeAgo value={item.updated_at} />{:else}—{/if}</dd>
				</div>
			</dl>
		</Card.Content>
	</Card.Root>


	<!-- Child sections -->
	<Card.Root>
		<Card.Header>
			<Card.Title>{m.common_related_records()}</Card.Title>
		</Card.Header>
		<Card.Content class="space-y-2">

			<!-- Child section accordion for Sub Task (SubTaskType) -->
<!-- Included from detail_page.tera inside the child_sections loop -->

<div class="border rounded-lg overflow-hidden">
	<!-- Collapsible header -->
	<button
		class="flex w-full items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 text-sm font-medium bg-muted/50 hover:bg-muted transition-colors"
		onclick={() => toggleSection('sub_task')}
		data-testid="child-section-sub_task"
		type="button"
	>
		<span class="flex items-center gap-2">
			<span>Sub Task</span>
			<span class="text-xs text-muted-foreground font-normal">
				({sub_taskItems.length})
			</span>
		</span>
		<span class="text-muted-foreground">
			{expandedSections.has('sub_task') ? '▼' : '▶'}
		</span>
	</button>

	<!-- Expanded content -->
	{#if expandedSections.has('sub_task')}
		<div class="p-4 space-y-3">
			<!-- Add button -->
			<div class="flex justify-end">
				<button
					class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md border px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium hover:bg-accent transition-colors"
					onclick={() => startAddChild('common', 'sub-task')}
					data-testid="child-section-sub_task-add-btn"
					type="button"
				>
					+ Add
				</button>
			</div>

			<!-- Items list -->
			{#if sub_taskItems.length === 0}
				<p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center py-4">No items yet.</p>
			{:else}
				<ul class="divide-y divide-border rounded-md border">
					{#each sub_taskItems as child (child.id)}
						<li class="flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2 text-sm">
							<span class="truncate text-foreground">
								{child.id}
							</span>
							<div class="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1 ml-2">
								<button
									class="rounded px-2 py-1 text-xs hover:bg-accent transition-colors"
									onclick={() => editChild('common', 'sub-task', child.id)}
									type="button"
								>
									Edit
								</button>
								<button
									class="rounded px-2 py-1 text-xs text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/10 transition-colors"
									onclick={() => deleteChild('common', 'sub-task', child.id)}
									type="button"
								>
									Delete
								</button>
								
								<button
									class="rounded px-2 py-1 text-xs hover:bg-accent transition-colors"
									onclick={() => manageChild('common', 'sub-task', child.id)}
									data-testid="manage-sub_task-btn"
									type="button"
								>
									Manage →
								</button>
								
							</div>
						</li>

			<AlertDialog.Title>{m.common_confirm_delete_title({ entity: 'TaskType' })}</AlertDialog.Title>

			<AlertDialog.Action

				data-testid="confirm-dialog-confirm"
				class="bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90"
			>
